title: Recover recipes after completed capture reports
changes: Cross-run recipe recovery permits completed UI, audio, code and gameplay start/report pairs while preserving their original requests and results without redispatch.
Open, duplicate or unmatched earlier collectors remain refused; remaining reports require a collector started after recovery.
validation: 87 focused Linux tests, Windows GNU runtime and test compilation, and 88 focused Wine tests passed.

An isolated Linux/Xvfb run completed one UI report, cancelled before the next step, restarted normally, resumed one frame, and verified unchanged JSON/HTML hashes, exactly one report and an unchanged second resume.
limitations: Report files are external local artifacts and recovery does not attest their continued presence or content.
Open prior collector restoration, real Wine GUI restart, native Windows and wider platform coverage remain open.
